messages:
elaine: Heads-up — found a bad curl sample in /docs/runtime/realtime-runtime.md. It uses POST /v1/generate and omits Authorization header; that example will 401 for new tokens. Also the FAQ has two 'Troubleshooting' H2s which collapses the mobile TOC. Anyone own that page?
samir: I own realtime-runtime.md. on it. I'll open a quick PR to fix the curl and merge the duplicate heading. ETA ~2h.
samir: bad snippet (current):
```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{ "model":"realtime-v1", "input":"hi" }'
```
fixed:
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/generate \
  -d '{"model":"realtime-v1","input":"hi"}'
```
docs-bot: docs-link-scan found 1 image 404 and 1 internal anchor warning in realtime-runtime.md — /assets/realtime-diagram.png (404), duplicate heading 'Troubleshooting' — https://ci.redwood/doc-scan/1977778888
maria: I can take the image — looks like the CDN path changed after the assets move. @eng-infra FYI if we need a redirect.
julian: FYI analytics: 4xx spikes from docs-bot crawler on 2026-03-16 03:20-03:45 UTC. Probably same issue.
noah: Please add a changelog line and smoke-test in staging. Also mark this as docs:hotfix so we can prioritize.
samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 — fixes curl, removes duplicate heading, updates image path to /assets/diagrams/realtime-diagram.png, adds changelog entry. Added label docs:hotfix.
elaine: awesome, can you assign to me for review and add 'owner:samir' label?
samir: assigned to @elaine, added owner:samir. Running staging deploy now.
deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded for docs PR #4822 — https://staging.docs.redwood/changes/4822 :rocket:
maria: :thumbsup:
elaine: thanks y'all. I'll review in ~30m.
